verdict.rationale: cubic's core function is generating AI insights and suggestions from the user's own code. It automatically reviews PRs for bugs, logic errors and security issues, generates PR summaries, and answers follow-up questions in comment threads. Codebase scans and an AI wiki with architecture diagrams extend this beyond single PRs, and one community user praises the depth of its technical explanations. Missing for 10: no evidence of AI-generated insights over the analytics data itself (the dashboards appear to be plain metrics), the in-product AI Q&A sidebar sits in archived docs, and independent hands-on corroboration is thin.
